name: WhatsApp LocalMind
alternateName: macOS WhatsApp 本地全量聊天提取器
description: Zero-dependency, strictly read-only macOS WhatsApp full-account local chat extractor (1-on-1 DMs, groups, channels, broadcast lists), structured cleaner, CLI, and JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP Stdio Server for AI Agents. Uses sqlite3_backup atomic snapshots with POSIX flock and ?mode=ro queries across ChatStorage.sqlite, LID.sqlite, and ContactsV2.sqlite, with optional chat_scope and blacklist/whitelist filtering and zero outbound network requests.
applicationSubCategory: Local-first Chat Data Extractor & MCP Server
featureList: SQLite Online Backup (sqlite3_backup) and POSIX flock atomic snapshots opened strictly via ?mode=ro
Full-account chat extraction across 1-on-1 DMs (@s.whatsapp.net, @lid, bare phone numbers), groups (@g.us), channels (@newsletter), and broadcast lists (excluding status@broadcast)
Configurable chat_scope (all, groups, direct, newsletter) and blacklist/whitelist policy enforcement with EXIT_POLICY_DENIED (3)
4-tier real-name resolution and bidirectional @lid <-> @s.whatsapp.net bridging across LID.sqlite, ContactsV2.sqlite, ZWACHATSESSION, ZWAGROUPMEMBER, and ZWAPROFILEPUSHNAME
Pure-Python zero-dependency Protobuf wire parser for ZWAMEDIAITEM.ZMETADATA 150-char reply chains and whitelisted @mentions
Monotonic incremental cursor (--after-id via ZWAMESSAGE.Z_PK) with 10-message context buffer and 24h out-of-bounds fallback
Reversible short-ack noise folding and on-demand sandboxed media export (.opus, .pdf, .xlsx, images, videos) with path traversal protection
10 CLI subcommands (+ list-chats and list-groups aliases), 5 read-only JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP Stdio tools, and SKILL.md agent bundle
softwareRequirements: macOS Full Disk Access (TCC) permission for terminal when reading live WhatsApp Group Containers
